gate_field_note: These gate fields refer only to the four internal project recall objectives.
deployment_interpretation: The system can be evaluated as a private website overlay that scores new posts, aggregates risk over time for each user, and prioritizes potentially high-risk users for moderator or qualified professional review. It is not an autonomous diagnostic system and must not independently make medical-emergency decisions.

primary_safety_objective.interpretation: The principal project objective was to surface users who may be experiencing severe or dangerous stress for human review. On the locked test, the model identified 20 of 26 Very-High posts.

moderate_class_context.interpretation: Moderate errors occur in both directions, indicating overlap near both adjacent boundaries rather than a single one-sided threshold problem.
operational_mitigations: use the continuous score rather than only the four-class label
aggregate multiple posts from the same user
prioritize posts close to either Moderate boundary
review strong disagreement between the two base models
show recent posting history to the human reviewer

required_before_real_world_operation: restricted moderator or professional dashboard access
offline replay to estimate alert volume and false-positive burden
required_next_evidence_for_future_model_: a fresh untouched dual-annotated confirmation set
further_work: Perform focused qualitative analysis of Moderate-to-Low and Moderate-to-High errors.
Acquire new dual annotations near both Moderate boundaries.
Use author- and thread-diverse active-learning candidates.
Reserve a new untouched confirmation set for future model improvement.
Evaluate ordinal outputs for stress greater than 3, 5, and 7.
Measure alert volume, false-positive burden, and reviewer workload through offline replay.
Define consent, privacy, access-control, audit-log, and escalation procedures.
